segments.name: Sohu
segments.description: Runs an online media content and services platform, selling marketing services and other online services to advertisers and users in the Chinese mainland.
segments.evidence: Sohu's main business is the marketing services business, which consists primarily of advertising and other marketing-related services.

segments.name: Changyou
segments.description: Develops and operates PC and mobile online games for game players alongside a platform channel business serving third-party advertisers.
segments.evidence: Changyou's dominant games are its PC game TLBB PC and its mobile game Legacy TLBB Mobile.

revenueModel.text: Advertisers pay for advertising placements and marketing services on Sohu's platform, while game players pay for virtual items in Changyou's games.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide advertisement placements and other marketing-related services to advertisers on our platform.

changes.text: In 2025, Sohu renamed its brand advertising business to the marketing services business.
changes.evidence: Starting in 2025, we changed the name of our "brand advertising business," as described in our previous annual and other reports with the SEC, to the "marketing services business."
